description: This file defines a Python module containing classes and functions to generate, manage, and invoke C++ template kernel code within the PyTorch compilation framework (Torch Inductor). It includes the CppTemplateKernel class for kernel code generation, buffer management, and code conversion utilities, as well as CppTemplateCaller for integrating these kernels into a compilation pipeline.

classes.name: CppTemplateKernel
classes.description: A class responsible for generating, defining, and invoking C++ template kernels for PyTorch's code generation process.

classes.name: CppTemplateCaller
classes.description: Represents a caller for C++ template kernels, handling precompilation, benchmarking, and integration into the IR.

methods.name: parse_expr_with_index_symbols(expr)
methods.description: Parses an expression, converting symbolic indices to sympy expressions with index symbols.
